_comment: Local fake FMS_UI-style app for trying the company-token flow: npm run mock (another terminal), then --env mock-fms. Users: any email, password pw; each user has two companies (Retail A / Dist B). localhost:4104 is an API called directly (mapped in hostServices); localhost:4105 is deliberately not listed, so discovery reports it as untracked. No authApiBaseUrl: the login clicks the first company in the picker and reads the exchange URL from the app's call. Users come from LT_FMS_USER_<n>_*.
name: mock-fms
